Bill.BriefDescription: Applying a purchasing preference to in-state businesses.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to applying a purchasing preference to in-statebusinesses; adding new sections to chapter 39.26 RCW; and repealing RCW39.26.260 and 39.26.271.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 39.26 RCWto read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: (1) In any purchase of goods or services using a competitive bidprocess, the department must give a ten percent preference to bids fromresponsible and responsive bidders from instate businesses. Thepreference is applied by lowering the dollar amount of the bid by tenpercent of the actual bid submitted. If the instate business isawarded the contract, the contract amount must be based on the originalbid. In the event of a tie bid between an instate and outofstatebusiness, the contract must be awarded to the instate business. (2) This section does not apply to the following: (a) Purchases through community rehabilitation programs under RCW39.26.230; (b) Purchases from inmate work programs under RCW 39.26.250 and39.26.251; p. 1 HB 1938 (c) Purchases of electronic products meeting environmentalperformance standards under RCW 39.26.265; (d) Purchases of goods and services made with federal funds; and (e) Cooperative purchasing under RCW 39.26.060.

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 39.26 RCWto read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: The department of enterprise services must post and regularlyupdate a list of businesses that have a contract for the provision ofgoods and services. The list must include the beginning date of thecontract, the contract amount, and any changes to the contract.

The following acts or parts of acts are eachrepealed: RCW 39.26.260 (PreferencesInstate procurement) and 1983 c183 s 1; and RCW 39.26.271 (Rules for reciprocity in bidding) and 2011 1stsp.s. c 43 s 241 & 1983 c 183 s 3.
